text: Zed Space Skin 是 DeepSeek Harness Web 的界面皮肤插件，为工作区加入海洋、宇宙和视频动态背景，并提供独立的设置面板。用户可以切换海面、事件视界、吸积涡旋或本地视频背景，调节波浪、日光、光影和玻璃透明度，也能单独调整对话区背景。插件支持自动昼夜变化、本地视频导入与管理，以及从在线画廊下载视频后应用。适合希望个性化 Harness 工作区外观、使用自选视频壁纸的用户；在线画廊需联网，本地视频保存在浏览器。

Zed Space Skin adds ocean, cosmic, and video backgrounds to DeepSeek Harness Web. Switch scenes, adjust waves and glass opacity, manage local clips, or download a wallpaper from the online gallery. The gallery needs a network connection.
想给 Harness 工作区换成会动的海面或宇宙背景。
能不能调整工作区背景的波浪、日光和透明度？
我想让背景随着时间自动切换昼夜效果。
如何把自己电脑里的短视频设成 Harness 壁纸？
有没有地方可以浏览并下载动态视频背景？
I want to personalize my Harness workspace with animated ocean or space scenes.
Can I use my own short MP4 or WebM as a looping background?
I need a wallpaper gallery where I can preview and add video backgrounds.
Zed Space Skin 的功能「动态场景切换」：把 Harness 背景切换为海面、事件视界或吸积涡旋，并在设置面板调整场景参数与自动光照。
Zed Space Skin 的功能「界面玻璃调节」：在设置面板调整工作区玻璃透明度，并为对话区域单独设置背景浓度。
Zed Space Skin 的功能「本地视频背景」：从本地多选导入 MP4 或 WebM，浏览已保存视频并选择、重命名或移除背景素材。
Zed Space Skin 的功能「在线视频画廊」：从视频背景面板打开画廊，下载选中的动态壁纸并保存到本地视频库，再明确应用为背景。
Zed Space Skin 的使用前须知：在线视频画廊从 zed-space.ai-cove.com 读取目录并下载所选视频，需要网络连接；已保存的视频可从本地视频库使用。

dsh-zed-space README · 当前功能：| 场景或功能 | 可以做什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 实时海洋 | 调节波浪、日光，或启用自动昼夜变化。 |
| 宇宙双视角 | 在地平线和漩涡视角间切换，分别调整光晕、星点与运动参数。 |
| 每场景参数 | 各场景保存自己的参数和玻璃浓度；可单独调整对话面板背景。 |
| 在线壁纸市场 | 浏览、预览和下载动态壁纸，保存到「我的视频」后应用。 |
| 本地视频库 | 多选导入、缩略图列表、勾选启用一个、重命名和移除，重新打开后恢复。 |
| 平滑切换 | 新画面就绪后交叠过渡；宇宙双视角在同一个渲染器内切换。 |

dsh-zed-space README · 当前功能：单个视频上限为 **32 MiB、30 秒、1080p**，支持范围及存储说明见[本地视频背景](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/blob/main/docs/video-background.md)。素材保存在本机，不会自动上传或随浏览器账号同步。**已接入[Zed Space 公网壁纸市场](https://zed-space.ai-cove.com/wallpapers)**：在「本地视频」中点击「发现官方精美动态皮肤」，即可搜索、预览和下载；校验入库后再显式应用。使用方式与网络范围见[壁纸市场接入](docs/market-integration.md)。

dsh-zed-space README · 安装：在 Harness 的「插件 → 添加插件」中输入 `dsh-zed-space@1.0.2`。Harness Web 可运行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-zed-space@1.0.2
```

也可从 [GitHub Release](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/releases/tag/v1.0.2) 下载 `dsh-zed-space-1.0.2.tgz`，将本地文件路径填入安装命令。安装后重启对应的 Harness 实例。

从 Backspace 升级时，先在同一 profile 卸载旧插件，再安装新包；保留原有配置与视频数据。详见[安装与迁移](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/blob/main/docs/install.zh.md)。

dsh-zed-space README · 本地构建与预览：需要 Node.js 20+。在仓库目录运行：

```sh
npm ci
npm run build
npm run build:site
npm test

`pages-dist/` 是官网静态产物，可通过本地 HTTP 服务预览。Pages 工作流只保留手动触发，不随 npm 或 GitHub Release 自动发布。

开发者接入方式见[插件构建说明](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/blob/main/docs/dsh-plugin.md)和[源码集成](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/blob/main/harness-plugin/README.md)。旧版迁移注意事项见[安装说明](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/blob/main/docs/install.zh.md)，不要删除整个 Harness 配置或会话目录。

dsh-zed-space README · 常见问题：**现在能从 npm 或市场安装新版吗？**

可按上方精确版本或 Release 文件安装。社区目录已收录，客户端索引按各市场的计划同步；各渠道状态见[发布记录](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/blob/main/docs/publishing/releases/1.0.2.md)。

**有共享壁纸市场吗？**

有。[Zed Space 壁纸市场](https://zed-space.ai-cove.com/wallpapers)已上线，DSH 插件可在画廊内浏览、下载到「我的视频」并应用，无需启动本地市场服务。已保存的视频可离线使用，详见[壁纸市场接入](docs/market-integration.md)。

dsh-zed-space README · Introduction：**1.0.2 · Package name: `dsh-zed-space`.** See the [release record](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/blob/main/docs/publishing/releases/1.0.2.md) for downloads and marketplace review status.

dsh-zed-space README · Introduction：This is an independent community plugin for DeepSeek Harness, not an official DeepSeek product or a skin for the DeepSeek web chat site.

dsh-zed-space README · Current features：| Scene or feature | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Live ocean | Adjust waves and daylight, or enable the automatic day cycle. |
| Two cosmic views | Switch between horizon and vortex, with separate glow, stars, and motion settings. |
| Per-scene settings | Keep scene parameters and glass opacity; optionally adjust the conversation background independently. |
| Wallpaper marketplace | Browse, preview, and download live wallpapers, then apply them from My Videos. |
| Local video library | Import multiple files, view thumbnails, enable one video, rename, remove, and restore after reopening. |
| Smooth transitions | Wait for the next frame before blending; both cosmic views transition within one renderer. |

dsh-zed-space README · Current features：Each video is limited to **32 MiB, 30 seconds, and 1080p**. See [local video background](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/blob/main/docs/video-background.md) for formats and storage details. Media stays on the device and is not automatically uploaded or synced through a browser account. **The plugin connects to the public [Zed Space wallpaper market](https://zed-space.ai-cove.com/wallpapers).** Open “Discover official animated skins” from “Local video” to browse, preview, and download; applying a downloaded video is a separate action. See [marketplace integration](docs/market-integration.md) for usage and network details.

dsh-zed-space README · Scene gallery：These five screenshots were captured in the real **DeepSeek Harness Web 0.2.1-rc.3** application with `dsh-zed-space@1.0.0` installed in a separate temporary profile. Each image shows the active wallpaper’s settings: glass opacity at its minimum of **40%**, with independent conversation opacity enabled at **60%**. The PNGs are compressed without resizing. See the [capture environment, settings, and media sources](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/blob/main/docs/screenshots/README.md).

dsh-zed-space README · Local video · deep dive：Both videos were imported through the local video library and played in the application. They are demonstration media and are not included with the plugin.

dsh-zed-space README · Installation：In Harness, open Plugins → Add plugin and enter `dsh-zed-space@1.0.2`. For Harness Web:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-zed-space@1.0.2
```

Alternatively, download `dsh-zed-space-1.0.2.tgz` from the [GitHub Release](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/releases/tag/v1.0.2) and install using its local path. Restart the corresponding Harness instance after installation.

dsh-zed-space README · Installation：When upgrading from Backspace, remove the old plugin from the same profile before adding the new one. Keep your settings and video data. See [installation and migration](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/blob/main/docs/install.zh.md).

dsh-zed-space README · Build and preview locally：Requires Node.js 20+. From the repository directory:

```sh
npm ci
npm run build
npm run build:site
npm test

`pages-dist/` contains the static website and can be previewed through a local HTTP server. Pages deployment is manual and does not run with npm or GitHub releases.

dsh-zed-space README · Build and preview locally：See [plugin integration](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/blob/main/docs/dsh-plugin.md), [source integration](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/blob/main/harness-plugin/README.md), and [migration notes](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/blob/main/docs/install.zh.md). Do not delete the entire Harness configuration or session directory.

dsh-zed-space README · Common questions：**Can I install this version from npm or a marketplace?**

Use the exact package version or Release file above. The community directory lists the plugin, while client indexes follow their own sync schedules. See the [release record](https://github.com/hetonghao/dsh-zed-space/blob/main/docs/publishing/releases/1.0.2.md).

**Is there a shared wallpaper marketplace?**

dsh-zed-space README · Common questions：Yes. The public [Zed Space wallpaper market](https://zed-space.ai-cove.com/wallpapers) lets you browse, download to “My videos,” and apply a video in DSH without running a local market server. Saved videos remain available offline. See [marketplace integration](docs/market-integration.md).

**Why is historical Backspace content still present?**

dsh-zed-space README · Common questions：This project evolved from Backspace. Historical changelog entries and media remain for provenance. Git tags in the current repository restart at `v1.0.0`.
